packageRules.description: AGP 9.3.x+ outruns what the locally installed Android Studio supports — sync fails with unsupported-AGP-version and "could not find compile target" errors. Hold AGP updates until Studio's bundled support catches up. Matched on depName with an unanchored prefix: Renovate names a Gradle plugin com.android.application:com.android.application.gradle.plugin, so the previous $-anchored matchPackageNames pattern never matched and AGP PRs kept being opened.
